articles.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea accuse each other of starting conflict after troops cross border
articles.description: Truckloads of Eritrean soldiers have been seen driving into Ethiopia, which has reportedly responded with drone strikes.

articles.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire speaks to BBC
articles.description: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

articles.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
articles.description: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.

articles.title: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
articles.description: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says the move will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.

articles.title: Three killed in Houthi-claimed strikes on Saudi Arabian airport
articles.description: Three Saudi citizens, including an airline pilot, were killed in attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, the country's civil aviation authority said.

articles.title: Lithuania PM confident of 'huge' NATO response if Russia attacks
articles.description: Lithuania is no stranger to the threat posed by Russia given its geography and history.

articles.title: One dead in Poland's second school attack in two days
articles.description: A school employee was killed and two others were injured after a knife attack in Poland - the second such incident in the country in two days
